design_quality_target.clarity: state machine is explicit and auditable
design_quality_target.traceability: every queue transition has history and failure cause
design_quality_target.resumability: running tasks with expired leases are recoverable per task
design_quality_target.verification: artifact existence and JSON validity are testable immediately

fifo_invariants: pending tasks keep an immutable sequence assigned at enqueue time
dequeue reads only pending tasks with dependencies satisfied
dequeue returns the lowest sequence among eligible pending tasks
priority remains planning metadata and does not override FIFO unless a future explicit policy changes queue_mode
completed and exhausted failed tasks are not returned by dequeue
running tasks require a lease_owner and lease_expires_at
a task retry creates an auditable failed attempt and returns the task to pending only when retry_count is below max_retries

pending.meaning: task is durable, not leased, and eligible when dependencies are satisfied

running.meaning: task has a single active worker lease and task-specific timeout

completed.meaning: task produced required evidence and validation passed

failed.meaning: task failed with recorded cause; terminal only when retry budget is exhausted

persistence_audit.history_strategy: append-only runtime/task_history.jsonl events controlled by the control plane
persistence_audit.failure_strategy: append-only runtime/failures.jsonl records with task_id, attempt, cause, and retry_decision
persistence_audit.checkpoint_strategy: task checkpoint_key points to runtime/checkpoints entries written by the control plane
persistence_audit.resume_strategy: on startup, expired running leases are reconciled before dequeue selects new pending work
